==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
There is a villain known as the Comic Lord. He has the power to bring comic characters to life and control their minds. He wears a very large black hat, glasses, and a long black cape.

I am not afraid of him, because I have a flying pet fish. My fish can shrink itself, split into clones, and shoot lasers from its eyes. He's a force to be reckoned with.

I approach a shopping mall, where Comic Lord is hiding out. Guarding the entrance is a giant reptilian monster with a skull for a head. I wake up before I get the chance to battle the beast.
